chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a quiet atmospheric entrance: a mist swell, a distant buoy bell chimes twice, the low bass begins its slow rocking}
positive_styles: 6/8 compound time with a slow rocking lilt
lonely breathy pulse-wave and flute lead, one drifting questioning phrase every two bars
faint bell-buoy chime arpeggios in triplet lilt
deep slow lilting synth bass rocking like a moored boat
almost no percussion, a soft noise wash swell like moving mist
haunting, lonely, misty night marsh, between places
